name: mpx/columns
title: Columns
description: Full-width two-column section. Solid or image background, per-column card backgrounds, Column 1 / Column 2 widths (desktop + tablet), gaps, and flip order.

attributes.label: Flip columns
attributes.help: Swaps the visual order on tablet and desktop (CSS order only — HTML stays the same). Column 1 / Column 2 width controls still target the first and second column in the HTML. On mobile the first column stays on top.

attributes.label: Vertical align
attributes.help: Aligns content inside both columns when they stretch to the same height. Default is top.

attributes.label: Sticky column
attributes.help: Desktop only: pin Column 1 (left) or Column 2 (right) while the other scrolls. Uses HTML order (same as width controls) — Flip changes which side appears left/right.
